<function name="ToHSV" parent="Color" type="classfunc">

	<file line="149-L153">lua/includes/util/color.lua</file>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>

	<description>

		Encodes a RGB <page>Color</page> into the [HSV color space](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HSL_and_HSV).

		This function uses <page>Global.ColorToHSV</page> internally.

	</description>
	
	<rets>
		<ret name="hue" type="number">
			Hue in degrees in range [0, 360)
		</ret>
		<ret name="saturation" type="number">
			Saturation in range [0, 1]
		</ret>
		<ret name="brightness" type="number">
			Brightness in range [0, 1]
		</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
